name: enterprise-cloud-platform
description: Document management platform built to demonstrate cloud infrastructure and security engineering. Runs locally in Docker; AWS designed in Terraform, not deployed.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w apps/web
